title: Jesus, I'm Tired Of Being Told To Be Grateful 😔
topic: she is in a long low season and every post telling her to count her blessings makes the dark feel worse

bible.text: The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light: they that dwell in the land of the shadow of death, upon them hath the light shined.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... every reel tonight said count your blessings. 😔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I do count them. The dark still comes back.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Gratitude in the light is easy. I never asked you to pretend the dark isn't dark.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Then why does thanking You feel like nothing changes?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Then why does thanking You feel like nothing changes in me?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: They didn't light that light. They kept walking, and it found them.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: The people in that verse didn't light the light. They kept walking, and it found them.
